name: Sylvan-Gibber
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, magnetic pole anomalies. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
